explanation: `AntitoneOn.mapsTo_uIcc` (same section, line 173) has exactly the same variable/typeclass assumptions and hypothesis `AntitoneOn f (uIcc a b)`, but concludes `MapsTo f (uIcc a b) (uIcc (f a) (f b))`. Since `Set.MapsTo f s t` is definitionally `∀ x ∈ s, f x ∈ t` and Mathlib proves `Set.mapsTo_iff_image_subset : MapsTo f s t ↔ f '' s ⊆ t` (with `Set.MapsTo.image_subset` the forward direction), this is the same statement in the image-subset surface form. Indeed the target's existing proof is precisely `hf.mapsTo_uIcc.image_subset`, applying this independent declaration.
